correctness.rationale: Exact spin identity and pair-correlations prove finite-n laws. For nh->infinity the weighted martingale difference array has deterministic predictable variance, negligible replacement error and maximum increment O((nh)^-1/2), while M^2 is negligible. For nh finite positive, independently generated Bernoulli switch times converge to a Poisson point process and the inversion area is almost-surely continuous at the limit path. For nh->0, single descending switches dominate positive inversions and occur at asymptotically uniform locations. 8284 exact rational assertions replayed; simulation checks are separate non-proof diagnostics.
